name: SONATA MANO Framework
what_it_is: A microservices-based NFV orchestration framework that forms the MANO core of the SONATA/5GTANGO service platform. It manages the full lifecycle of network services and virtual network functions (VNFs) across heterogeneous virtualization infrastructures.
components: Service Lifecycle Management (SLM) — primary orchestration engine for end-to-end service workflows
Specific Manager Registry (SMR) — registry and dispatcher for service-specific managers (SSMs) and function-specific managers (FSMs)
Placement Plugin — computes resource placement and optimization decisions
SSMs (Service-Specific Managers) — per-service customization plugins injected at runtime
FSMs (Function-Specific Managers) — per-VNF customization plugins injected at runtime
protocols: AMQP via RabbitMQ — asynchronous inter-component messaging bus
REST (implied) — interface to external VIMs such as OpenStack and Kubernetes
configuration: VIM backend selectable: local emulation via son-emu, OpenStack, or Kubernetes
Orchestration behavior customizable per service/function via SSM/FSM plugins without modifying core code
Data persistence backed by MongoDB, SONATA Catalogue, and Repository
constraints: Requires RabbitMQ message broker to be running for all inter-component communication
SSMs and FSMs must be registered with SMR before they can be invoked during lifecycle events
No built-in monitoring or telemetry pipeline documented — external tooling required for metrics collection
Placement decisions are plugin-driven; no default multi-constraint optimizer is documented
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found in the repository root (404 on both master branch attempts)
No documented fault injection or chaos testing support
No load balancing or autoscaling policy engine described
Monitoring/telemetry integration not covered in README
